title: Concept: Classic ASP.NET error page disclosed in a response
description: The classic ASP.NET unhandled-exception page prints the exception message, the failing source line and an assembly-qualified stack frame. Serving it discloses the application layout and the exact line that failed, which is the reconnaissance a targeted exploit needs.
applicability: Responses generated by an ASP.NET application running with custom errors disabled.
risk: The caller reads the exception message and the assembly and source paths of the failing handler, which describes the application internals and the code path to attack next.
